title: Signature Calm Cut Suite
concept: An operating room where the walls display a slow dawn gradient and the team speaks in calm, rehearsed phrases, designed around evidence that calmer rooms mean steadier hands. Patient anxiety before anesthesia drops measurably. Concept by Manon.
improvement_over_conventional: Improves on stark, noisy ORs with an environment engineered for surgical calm.
patient_flow: Patients check in, change, and wait in pre-op holding where the surgeon marks the site and anesthesia reviews the plan. In the OR, the team does a time-out — confirming patient, site, and procedure aloud — then operates. Afterward the patient wakes in PACU under close monitoring until discharge criteria are met, then goes to a floor, home, or ICU.
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.

title: Signature Count Chime

improvement_over_conventional: Improves on verbal counts with an audible harmony of correctness.
